mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS shift_schedule_id, CONCAT(st.template_name, ' ', st.start_time, '-', st.end_time) AS label, s.scheduled_start_time AS start_time, s.scheduled_end_time AS end_time, s.scheduled_break_minutes AS break_minutes, s.work_day_type AS work_day_type FROM shift_schedule s LEFT JOIN shift_template st ON st.id = s.shift_template_id AND st.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND s.work_date = #{workDate}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO attendance_daily ( tenant_id, employee_id, work_date, shift_schedule_id, work_day_type, scheduled_start_time, scheduled_end_time, scheduled_break_minutes, scheduled_work_minutes, actual_clock_in, actual_clock_out, actual_break_minutes, actual_work_minutes, late_minutes, early_leave_minutes, absence_minutes, normal_work_minutes, overtime_minutes, legal_overtime_minutes, night_work_minutes, holiday_work_minutes, status, approval_status, exception_flag, locked, calculated_at, calc_version, calc_message, created_at, updated_at ) KEY (tenant_id, employee_id, work_date) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{employeeId}, #{workDate}, #{shiftScheduleId}, #{workDayType}, #{scheduledStartTime}, #{scheduledEndTime}, #{scheduledBreakMinutes}, #{scheduledWorkMinutes}, #{actualClockIn}, #{actualClockOut}, #{actualBreakMinutes}, #{actualWorkMinutes}, #{lateMinutes}, #{earlyLeaveMinutes}, #{absenceMinutes}, #{normalWorkMinutes}, #{overtimeMinutes}, #{legalOvertimeMinutes}, #{nightWorkMinutes}, #{holidayWorkMinutes}, #{status}, #{approvalStatus}, #{exceptionFlag}, #{locked}, #{calculatedAt}, #{calcVersion}, #{calcMessage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO attendance_exception ( tenant_id, employee_id, work_date, attendance_daily_id, exception_type, exception_level, status, message, suggested_action, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{employeeId}, #{workDate}, #{attendanceDailyId}, #{exceptionType}, #{exceptionLevel}, #{status}, #{message}, #{suggestedAction}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO attendance_calc_log ( tenant_id, employee_id, work_date, attendance_daily_id, trigger_type, trigger_ref_id, calc_status, step_name, step_message, payload_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{employeeId}, #{workDate}, #{attendanceDailyId}, #{triggerType}, #{triggerRefId}, #{calcStatus}, #{stepName}, #{stepMessage}, #{payloadJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.employee_id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, dept.department_name, wp.workplace_name, d.work_date, CONCAT(COALESCE(st.template_name, '未排班'), CASE WHEN st.start_time IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' ', st.start_time, '-', st.end_time) END) AS schedule_label, d.actual_clock_in, d.actual_clock_out, d.actual_break_minutes, d.actual_work_minutes, d.late_minutes, d.early_leave_minutes, d.status, d.exception_flag FROM attendance_daily d INNER JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.employee_id AND e.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = e.department_id AND dept.tenant_id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN workplace wp ON wp.id = e.workplace_id AND wp.tenant_id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN shift_schedule ss ON ss.id = d.shift_schedule_id AND ss.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN shift_template st ON st.id = ss.shift_template_id AND st.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE ORDER BY d.work_date DESC, e.employee_no ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
